dct_description_sm: This project aimed to develop a climate change adaptation plan for Wagmatcook First Nation Reserve.   The short term objectives for the project were: to develop the adaptation plan, identifying a specific implementation strategy for the Wagmatcook First Nation; and to develop and incorporate awareness building exercises into community events and organizations.   The long-term objective of the project was to promote climate change adaptation in the community so that it is used to guide future development plans (for example, to determine what areas are zoned for development, how water issues are addressed, how natural resources are extracted for commercial and traditional uses, etc.) The community has proven to be innovative in the context of climate change and will provide to be an important example for other communities to follow in the future.
